text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Winding the clock back a little, to just 
around the end of our summer training 
camp.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A single concern had arisen.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, haa, haa... Ugh, *cough, cough*!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Phew... haah... ngh.
choice_data_list: Shall we put in a short break?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Y-Yeees~.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Might not have much aptitude for long 
distances"... ...is that what you said?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We had incorporated serious long-distance 
training in preparation for the Kikuka 
Sho, but during that time, a faint sense 
of unease lingered.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For all the work she puts in, the results 
are a bit lacking. Her hard work just 
isn't quite reflecting in her performance—
choice_data_list: The Kikuka Sho might be a tough battle.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's not that I want to give up. However, 
things may not turn out as hoped... and I 
wanted to make sure you were aware of that 
possibility.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Actually, I had kind of sensed it too.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(My stamina really is lacking, huh. If I'm 
going to compete in the Kikuka Sho, I've 
still got a long way to go.)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking maybe I just don't have 
much aptitude for it.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Still.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Still, you never know until you try, 
right!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Look, they always say nothing is 
guaranteed in a race, and in the end, you 
won't know until you run it, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume favored to win can finish off 
the board, while an overlooked contender 
can take the crown. That's racing.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Right. That's why... precisely because 
it's a distance I've never tried before, I 
want to believe there's still a chance."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Besides—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I still want to win! If there's even the 
slightest chance, I want to bet on it...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
By winning the Kikuka Sho, as "the 
strongest Umamusume"!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I want to become the leading star of this 
era!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Straightforward words without a trace of 
flinching. Her unexpected demeanor makes 
me straighten my back.
choice_data_list:
You're right, my bad. Let's give it 
everything we've got!

You're right, sorry. Let's give it 
everything we've got!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our even fiercer days leading up 
to the Kikuka Sho had begun!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Hah! Haa! Haa... haa!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes! Of course...! I can do one more 
rep...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Focus on breathing... Relax your form even 
more.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Alright, once more...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Phew, haah! Phew, whew!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, aaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Not yet, not... yetttttt!!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaaaahhhhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, the final leg of the Classic Triple 
Crown! Amidst the fragrant autumn breeze, 
the Kikuka Sho begins.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Hell yeahh!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The focus is on Jungle Pocket. Her 
fighting spirit has surged even higher 
since the Japanese Derby!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(There are no absolutes in racing. You 
never know until you try, that's why—)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you that I can become the 
strongest Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Who will claim undisputed right to the 
title of strongest Umamusume!?"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And now, the final leg of the Classic 
Triple Crown— The Kikuka Sho begins once 
again this year!
